scene.label: Act 5, Scene 1
scene.title: SCENE I. Salisbury. An open place

content.text: Enter Sheriff and Halberds, with Buckingham, led to execution.

lines.text: Will not King Richard let me speak with him?
lines.plainText: Will not King Richard let me speak with him

lines.text: No, my good lord; therefore be patient.
lines.plainText: No my good lord therefore be patient

lines.text: Hastings, and Edward's children, Grey, and Rivers,
lines.plainText: Hastings and Edward's children Grey and Rivers

lines.text: Holy King Henry, and thy fair son Edward,
lines.plainText: Holy King Henry and thy fair son Edward

lines.text: Vaughan, and all that have miscarried
lines.plainText: Vaughan and all that have miscarried

lines.text: By underhand, corrupted foul injustice,
lines.plainText: By underhand corrupted foul injustice

lines.text: If that your moody discontented souls
lines.plainText: If that your moody discontented souls

lines.text: Do through the clouds behold this present hour,
lines.plainText: Do through the clouds behold this present hour

lines.text: Even for revenge mock my destruction.
lines.plainText: Even for revenge mock my destruction

lines.text: This is All-Souls' day, fellow, is it not?
lines.plainText: This is AllSouls' day fellow is it not

lines.text: It is.
lines.plainText: It is

lines.text: Why, then All-Souls' day is my body's doomsday.
lines.plainText: Why then AllSouls' day is my body's doomsday

lines.text: This is the day which, in King Edward's time,
lines.plainText: This is the day which in King Edward's time

lines.text: I wished might fall on me when I was found
lines.plainText: I wished might fall on me when I was found

lines.text: False to his children and his wife's allies.
lines.plainText: False to his children and his wife's allies

lines.text: This is the day wherein I wished to fall
lines.plainText: This is the day wherein I wished to fall

lines.text: By the false faith of him whom most I trusted.
lines.plainText: By the false faith of him whom most I trusted

lines.text: This, this All-Souls' day to my fearful soul
lines.plainText: This this AllSouls' day to my fearful soul

lines.text: Is the determined respite of my wrongs.
lines.plainText: Is the determined respite of my wrongs

lines.text: That high All-Seer which I dallied with
lines.plainText: That high AllSeer which I dallied with

lines.text: Hath turned my feigned prayer on my head
lines.plainText: Hath turned my feigned prayer on my head

lines.text: And given in earnest what I begged in jest.
lines.plainText: And given in earnest what I begged in jest

lines.text: Thus doth He force the swords of wicked men
lines.plainText: Thus doth He force the swords of wicked men

lines.text: To turn their own points in their masters' bosoms.
lines.plainText: To turn their own points in their masters' bosoms

lines.text: Thus Margaret's curse falls heavy on my neck:
lines.plainText: Thus Margaret's curse falls heavy on my neck

lines.text: "When he," quoth she, "shall split thy heart with sorrow,
lines.plainText: When he quoth she shall split thy heart with sorrow

lines.text: Remember Margaret was a prophetess."
lines.plainText: Remember Margaret was a prophetess

lines.text: Come lead me, officers, to the block of shame;
lines.plainText: Come lead me officers to the block of shame

lines.text: Wrong hath but wrong, and blame the due of blame.
lines.plainText: Wrong hath but wrong and blame the due of blame
